items.headline: Myanmar Rohingya case: ICJ faisla 19 Nov ko
items.detail: ICJ ne kaha Gambia ke case me Myanmar ke khilaf antim faisla 19 November ko The Hague me sunaya jayega; Myanmar ne aaropon se inkaar kiya hai.
items.exam_angle: ICJ aur antarrashtriya kanoon: International exams ke liye — Rohingya case aur Genocide Convention.

items.headline: Congo se Ebola patient UK bheja jayega
items.detail: Congo me Ebola positive paye gaye British healthcare worker ko specialist ilaaj ke liye UK bheja ja raha hai; sarkar ne kaha janata ko khatra kam hai.
items.exam_angle: Ebola aur global health suraksha: International exams ke liye — sankramak rog aur medical evacuation.

items.headline: Ukraine-Russia-America: Abu Dhabi me 10-11 Nov baatchit
items.detail: Zelenskyy ne Witkoff aur Kushner se 90 minute baat ki; team-level trilateral baatchit Abu Dhabi me 10-11 November ko hogi, suraksha guarantee aur hawai raksha par charcha hui.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh: shanti vaarta aur suraksha guarantee — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Bangladesh: December se garment mazdooron ka naya vetan
items.detail: Naye wage board ne December se sanshodhit vetan dhancha lagu karne par sahamati di; pehli badhi hui salary January me milegi, lekin vetan ka aakar abhi tay nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh: vastr udyog aur shramik vetan — padosi desh ki arthvyavastha ke liye.

items.headline: Thailand ke mantri 12 Nov ko Myanmar jayenge
items.detail: Videsh mantri Sihasak Phuangketkeow 12 November ko Myanmar jayenge; seema par jhadap aur ASEAN shikhar sammelan se pehle Myanmar ka rukh janenge.
items.exam_angle: ASEAN: Myanmar sankat aur seema suraksha — dakshin-poorv Asia ke liye.

items.headline: Michigan: El-Sayed pehle Muslim Senator bane
items.detail: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed ne Republican Mike Rogers ko harakar Michigan se Senate seat jeeti; ve America ke pehle Muslim Senator banenge.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate chunav aur aitihasik pehchan.

items.headline: Muji: 10.9 lakh card number leak ho sakte
items.detail: Japan ki Muji operator Ryohin Keikaku ne kaha lagbhag 1.09 million MUJI Card record, jinme card number shamil hain, leak ho sakte hain; lagbhag 345,000 card abhi valid hain.
items.exam_angle: Cyber suraksha aur data sanrakshan: International exams ke liye — Japan me bada data leak.

items.headline: Komyshuvakha hamle me marne wale 40 hue
items.detail: Zelenskyy ne kaha sahayata kendra par hamle me 40 log mare gaye, 33 se badhkar, aur 30 se zyada abhi malbe ke neeche ho sakte hain.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh aur nagrik suraksha: International exams ke liye — sahayata kendra par hamla.

items.headline: Texas: Talarico 1988 ke baad pehle Democrat Senator
items.detail: Democrat James Talarico ne Republican Ken Paxton ko harakar Texas se 1988 ke baad pehli baar Senate seat jeeti; ve sabse yuva Senator bane.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — Senate aur midterm chunav.

items.headline: North Korea ne samundar ki taraf missile chhode
items.detail: South Korea ki sena ne kaha Sondok se kai missile chhode gaye, Binance hack ke aarop par America se baatchit se inkaar ke kuch ghante baad.
items.exam_angle: Korea prayadweep aur kootneeti: International exams ke liye — missile parikshan aur America se tanaav.

items.headline: UN: Jalvayu madad zaroorat se bahut kam
items.detail: UNEP ki 2026 Adaptation Gap Report me kaha gaya vikas-sheel deshon ko 2035 tak saalana lagbhag $305 billion ki zaroorat hai, jabki 2024 me sirf $28.2 billion mile; madad teen guna badhane par bhi sirf 20-29% zaroorat poori hogi.
items.exam_angle: Jalvayu vitt aur COP31: International exams ke liye — adaptation finance ka antar.

items.headline: Ramaphosa: America chunav se naya daur
items.detail: Rashtrapati Cyril Ramaphosa ne kaha America ke midterm natijon se duniya ke sambandhon me naya daur shuru ho sakta hai; unhone AGOA se hataye jaane par dwipakshiya vyapaar samjhaute par dhyaan dene ki baat kahi.
items.exam_angle: South Africa-America sambandh: International exams ke liye — AGOA aur vyapaar.

items.headline: Israel: Chunav natije pramanit, vivad jaari
items.detail: Israel ki Central Elections Committee ne 27 October ke chunav ke natije pramanit karke Rashtrapati Herzog ko saunp diye; aayog ko dhokhadhadi ka koi saboot nahi mila, jabki Netanyahu ne daave jaari rakhe.
items.exam_angle: Israel ki rajneeti: International exams ke liye — chunav aur sarkar gathan.

items.headline: China: America se sahyog jaari rahega
items.detail: Videsh mantralaya ki pravakta Mao Ning ne kaha chunav America ka andaruni mamla hai aur China netaon ke samjhaute par sahyog jaari rakhega.
items.exam_angle: China-America sambandh: International exams ke liye — chunav ke baad kootneeti.

items.headline: Germany: Ukraine ko €200 million sardiyon ki madad
items.detail: Chancellor Merz ne Berlin mein Zelenskyy se milkar €200 million ki sardiyon ki madad ka elan kiya; manaviya sahayata aur urja supply ke liye hai, Bundestag ki manzoori baaki hai.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh aur sardiyon ka sankat: Germany ki madad aur urja suraksha.

items.headline: Philippines: Bahut tez El Niño ki chetavni
items.detail: PAGASA ne kaha bahut tez El Niño ab maujood hai, 2027 ki pehli timahi tak rahega aur 87 ilakon mein sookha aa sakta hai.
items.exam_angle: El Niño aur jalvayu: International exams ke liye — sookha aur krishi par asar.

items.headline: Philippines-China: Baatchit jaari rakhne ka vaada
items.detail: Videsh mantriyon Lazaro aur Wang Yi ne phone par baat ke baad samvaad jaari rakhne ka vaada kiya, ASEAN shikhar sammelan se pehle tanaav kam karne ki koshish hai.
items.exam_angle: ASEAN aur South China Sea: International exams ke liye — vivaad aur kootneeti.

items.headline: Khamenei: America ki dushmani nahi badlegi
items.detail: Khamenei ne kaha America ki neeti dal badalne se nahi badlegi aur dobara hamla hua to jawab aur bada hoga.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran sambandh: International exams ke liye — chunav par yuddh ka asar.

items.headline: Alaska: Badi dauden abhi anirnit
items.detail: Alaska ki Senate, governor aur House daudon mein abhi koi vijeta ghoshit nahi hua; 50% se zyada pehli pasand na mile to ranked-choice ginati 18 November ko hogi, pramanikaran 25 November ko.
items.exam_angle: America mein ranked-choice voting: chunav vyavastha.

items.headline: Nevada: Ford pehle Black governor bane
items.detail: Democrat Aaron Ford ne Republican Governor Joe Lombardo ko harakar Nevada ke pehle Black governor banne ka itihas racha; ve rajya ke attorney general the.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — governor chunav.

items.headline: Indonesia: Chief of staff barkhast, tapping aarop
items.detail: Rashtrapati Prabowo ne apne chief of staff Listyo Sigit Prabowo ko barkhast kar diya; unpar rashtrapati aur mantriyon ke phone ki gair-kanuni tapping ka aarop hai, aur sarkar ka kehna hai yah deshdroh ki shreni mein aa sakta hai.

items.headline: Iran: Matdataon ne yuddh ko na kaha
items.detail: Sansad adhyaksh Ghalibaf ne kaha America ke matdataon ne 'NO TO WAR' ka sandesh diya hai aur chetavni di ki janmat ko nazarandaaz karne par parinam bhugatne honge.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran sambandh: International exams ke liye — chunav par yuddh ka asar.

items.headline: Trump: Iran yuddh ne haar mein bhoomika nibhayi
items.detail: Trump ne Democrats ko badhai di aur Fox News ko kaha Iran yuddh aur tel ki kimaton ne Republicans ki haar mein hissa nibhaya; veeto ki chetavni bhi di.
items.exam_angle: America ki chunav vyavastha: International exams ke liye — yuddh ka chunav parinam par asar.
